name: Ninja Creami Vanilla Ice Cream
desc: The reliable Ninja Creami base, kept smooth by a spoonful of cream cheese.

source.title: Ninja Creami Vanilla Ice Cream
source.evidence: Same standard-pint amounts (1 tbsp cream cheese, 1/3 cup sugar, 1 tsp vanilla, 1 cup whole milk, 3/4 cup heavy cream) and the same microwave-the-cream-cheese method; this version adds a pinch of salt.

steps: Microwave the cream cheese in a large microwave-safe bowl for about 10 seconds, until soft. Add the sugar and mix with a spatula into a thick, smooth paste.
Whisk in the milk and cream a little at a time, then the vanilla and salt, until the sugar has fully dissolved.
Pour into a Ninja Creami pint, no higher than the max fill line. Lid it and freeze on a level surface for 24 hours.
Spin the fully frozen pint on the Ice Cream setting.
If it looks crumbly, run Re-spin once. For chips or cookies, dig a hole down the center to the bottom, add them, and run the Mix-In setting. Serve right away.
tips: For a Deluxe pint, By Kelsey Smith scales it to 1 1/2 tbsp cream cheese, 1/2 cup sugar, 1 1/2 tsp vanilla, and 1 1/3 cups each whole milk and heavy cream.

references.title: Ninja Creami Vanilla Ice Cream
references.usedFor: confirmed amounts, max fill line, re-spin and mix-in method, deluxe pint scaling, 4 servings
